finding: Cross-checking the live Arabic row against KSU Tabari p. 602 lines 21–40 yields three separately headed groups of transmitted identifications followed by a distinct authorial preference. Group 1 is headed as al-As ibn Wa'il and contains eight displayed report units with varied phrasing; group 2 is headed as Uqba ibn Abi Mu'ayt and contains one report; group 3 is headed as a group of Quraysh and contains three report units. Tabari then says the verse's description applies to anyone who hates the Messenger, even if revelation concerned a particular person. This conclusion is not another named referent report and does not erase the preceding reports or deny a specific occasion.
